text: The mercenary captains are either capable men or they are not; if they are, you cannot trust them, because they always aspire to their own greatness, either by oppressing you, who are their master, or others contrary to your intentions; but if the captain is not skilful, you are ruined in the usual way.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
locator: Chapter XII, How many kinds of soldiery there are and concerning mercenaries
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
